card.name: Words for bad outcomes or penalties
card.fires_on: The word naming a penalty, risk or consequence, right after words like fear of, risk of, potential, or serious. Also the word "if" in worry-about-what-happens clauses.

modes.label: Consequence nouns
modes.description: A noun for a bad result such as punishment, repercussions, consequences, harm or death after a risk-style modifier.
modes.example: without fear of<< repercussions>> or penalty from anyone

modes.label: Worry clause
modes.description: The word "if" introducing a feared outcome of an action.
modes.example: worried about what will happen<< if>> you report it to the police
